buy_title: The six worked examples, and what to check on each listing
buy_kicker: Our top pick, and our last word
buy_total: The buttons show today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Our price lines come from US retailers other than Amazon on the dates named.

cards.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
cards.badge: Top pick · a real deal under a fake “reg” price

photo.credit: Photo: Burkhard Mücke, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $179.99 at Target (its “reg” $249.99 is 99¢ above Apple's own $249) on Nov 20, 2026; Walmart and Best Buy about $199.99. 2025 holiday low $219.99; 2026 low $169.99 at Walmart on June 15 (Slickdeals).
cards.buy_if: you use an iPhone and want noise cancelling: the reference price is padded, but $179.99 is still $40 under last year's holiday low, and Target pays back its own drops until Dec 24.
cards.skip_if: you use Android (Sony or Pixel Buds fit better), or the “deal” is on AirPods Pro 2 or AirPods 4, which are different, older or open-fit models.
cards.owners: Owners and reviewers praise the noise cancelling and heart-rate sensing (9to5Mac, Dec 2025); complaints are fit (Apple Community, SoundGuys, autumn 2025) and static with noise cancelling on (MacRumors, Oct 29 and Dec 18, 2025).

buy.pick: AirPods Pro 3 (the 2025 model with heart-rate sensing), not AirPods Pro 2 or AirPods 4
buy.check: The box and listing say AirPods Pro 3 and “heart rate sensing”; sold by Amazon.com or Apple; $190 or less is our good line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: REDTIGER F7NP 4K Front and Rear Dash Cam
cards.badge: Car · the crossed-out price moves; the real one doesn't
cards.price: $93.49 without a card and $109.99 with a 128GB card at REDTIGER's store (crossed out $129.99 and $169.99) on Nov 20, 2026; a $157.13 “regular” price in Nov 2025 and Walmart's “was $199.99” (search result).
cards.buy_if: you want front and rear video under $110: REDTIGER's own Nov 19–30 sale puts it inside our lines, and last year's best was about $99.99 with a code.
cards.skip_if: you want true 4K: REDTIGER's own May 2026 buying guide lists the F7NP as “4K (Upscaled)”, and DashCamTalk says the F7N family's 4K is interpolated.
cards.owners: DashCamTalk rates daytime front video well and the rear camera and app as weak, with rare firmware updates; Walmart buyers praise the easy install (page seen Nov 2026).
cards.video_title: REDTIGER F7NP Dual Dash Cam Review & Driving Video
cards.video_why: A driving test of the exact F7NP; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The F7NP front-and-rear kit, not the front-only F7NS or the older F7N; decide whether you want the 128GB card bundle before comparing prices
buy.check: The listing names F7NP and says which card size is in the box (32GB or 128GB); $110 or less with a 128GB card is our line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Bissell Little Green (1400B)
cards.badge: Cleaning · the “was” price is real; the cheap one is another model
cards.price: $94.99 at Bissell (was $129.99, a price Bissell charged on Oct 29 and Nov 16) on Nov 20, 2026; Walmart's 1400B $95.99–$110 and out of stock (search results). The $75 Walmart deals are the 3369, a different model.
cards.buy_if: you clean pet accidents, kid spills and car seats: $94.99 at Bissell is the lowest dated 1400B price we found, measured from a list Bissell really charges.
cards.skip_if: you want whole-room carpet cleaning (rent an upright), or the deal is on a 3369, Pet Pro 2891/3909 or ProHeat you have not compared.
cards.owners: Owners praise it on pet and food stains; the repeated complaints are a hose that cracks at the tank joint (Sam's Club reviews, seen Nov 2026) and weak or fading suction (Best Buy reviews of the ProHeat sibling).
cards.video_title: 6 years with the Bissell Little Green — a long-term review

buy.pick: The Little Green 1400B, not the Mini (3369 or 4064T) or the ProHeat (2513W), which are different machines
buy.check: The model reads 1400B; sold by Bissell, Amazon.com or a big-box store; under $100 is our good line, $85 our great line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
cards.badge: Kitchen · “30% off” from a price few people pay

photo.credit: Photo: BenFrantzDale, CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $349.99 at Target (“reg $499.99”) and $349.95 at Walmart on Nov 20, 2026; Best Buy $379.99 (White, search result). Popular colours sat near $350–$450 most of 2026. 2025 lows: $297.49 at Target with 15% in cart (Nov 30) and $299 at Lowe's (Dec 26).
cards.buy_if: you bake weekly: $350 is fair, under $300 is what last year's Black Friday weekend reached, and Target's holiday match pays back its own drops.
cards.skip_if: you mostly knead heavy bread dough (a bowl-lift suits it better), or the listing is a KSM150 bundle code or Costco's Artisan Plus you can't compare like for like.
cards.owners: Owners praise power and colours (Target and Best Buy review summaries, seen Nov 2026); the long-running complaints are grease seeping from the gearbox, the plastic worm gear that strips by design, and walking on stiff dough (iFixit, The Daily Meal).

buy.pick: The Artisan Series 5-quart tilt-head, model KSM150 (KSM150PS plus a colour code), not the 4.5-quart Classic or the 3.5-quart Artisan Mini
buy.check: The model number starts KSM150; sold by KitchenAid, Amazon.com or a big-box store; a sale on one colour only is normal, so pick the colour after the price
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
cards.badge: Kitchen · the $109.99 list is real at one store only

photo.credit: Photo: Ajay Suresh, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $109.99 at Instant Pot's store with no discount (Nov 20, 2026); Home Depot $99.99 (search result); Walmart's third-party listings $143–$145, above the maker's list. Target's listing no longer loads.
cards.buy_if: you want one pot for beans, stock and rice and you see $80 or less: that is what stores other than the maker usually charge in a sale.
cards.skip_if: you mostly air-fry, or the listing is a Duo Plus, a Rio, a “V5 refurbished” unit or a bundle you did not price.
cards.owners: Owners like the time saved; the common complaints are a sealing ring that holds smells and “Burn” errors fixed by a new ring (r/instantpot, Mar 2025), and slow warranty replies (BBB complaints, 2025).
cards.video_title: Instant Pot DUO 6QT Full Review & First Look
cards.video_why: A review of the exact 6-quart size; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The Duo 6-quart 7-in-1 (IP-DUO60 / 112-0170-01), new, not refurbished, not the Duo Plus or Rio
buy.check: Sold by Instant Pot, Amazon.com or a big-box store, not a marketplace seller above $110; $80 or less is our good line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40 1000A Jump Starter
cards.badge: Car · an honest list price and inflated “was” prices
cards.chip: 1,000 A · 12 V · up to 6 L gas

photo.credit: Photo: Tony Webster, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons (earlier label)

cards.price: $99.95 list at NOCO, Home Depot and most Walmart listings (Nov 2026, search results); Best Buy $115.99, above the maker's list; marketplace “was” prices of $125–$139. Home Depot $74.95 with a card offer (Nov 10, 2026).
cards.buy_if: you need a jump starter before the first cold snap: $99.95 is an honest price, and we found no non-Amazon Black Friday cut for 2025 or 2026.
cards.skip_if: you drive a V8 over 6 liters or a diesel over 3 liters (the GB50 or GB70 is the right size, per NOCO's chart).
cards.owners: Owners report years of starts, including a 5.3-liter truck at 20°F (Garage Journal); complaints are slow recharging and units that stop charging (ProductReview.com.au, undated).
cards.video_title: How to jump start using your NOCO Boost GB40
cards.video_why: The three-step jump-start routine, shown on a real car; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The GB40 (1000A, gas up to 6.0 L, diesel up to 3.0 L), not the GB50 or GB70
buy.check: Sold by NOCO, Amazon.com or a big-box store; ignore any “was” above $99.95; $80 or less is our good line
buy.label: See today's price
